method: Each listing (platform suffix and edition words stripped) matched against the finalized runtime census (tools/lib/runtime-census.mjs): identity titles, aliases and DATA.p physical products; then against audit-out/ALL_BATCHES_01-05_completed.csv; then rule classifiers (annual sports, PSVR) and a strict token-subset match with roman-numeral normalization. Nothing here changes census data.
note: NOT_IN_CENSUS_NEEDS_PHYSICAL_RESEARCH is an upper bound: a few rows are still spelling variants the matcher could not prove (nearestCensus shows the closest identity). These rows are the input for a Batch 06 research pass; none were added without physical-release evidence.
